text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leeet's see here. Lemons? Check!
Teensy light
bulbs? Check! I bought
everything I need for
science class!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, what the heck?! What is the
teacher thinking
making a witch run
herself ragged doing all this
shopping?!

text_block_list.name: Dog Walker
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me! Can you grab that dog!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, get your act together! You need to
control
your familiar!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible burst of speed!
It's like you
went from zero to a hundred
in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You were just saying you were tired too!
Is that
the power of magic?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Well, sure it was! It's something
us
witches work hard at every day.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, the most important
time to
pick up the speed and run is
when I'm tired?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh... I guess Granny did always say that a witch shows her true worth when her magic runs short.
choice_data_list: スパートの爆発力も上げていきたいんだ
スパートの爆発力も上げていきたいの
choice_data_list_en: I want to boost the explosive power of my final spurt, too.
I want to boost the explosive power of my final spurt, too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do it. But if it seems like
you're
wasting my time, I'm outta here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...
I guess it wasn't a waste of time after
all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Everything okay? Did something
happen the
other day?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
N-no, nothing! Anyway, I'm heading
home early!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Well, I guess that familiar is a little
useful after
all. Just a little!)
